questions.question: Tell me about yourself, and what brings you to this role.
strong_answer_covers: two or three highlights that fit this job
an ending that explains why this role
follow_ups: What part of your background fits this role best?

questions.question: Tell me about a time you found a mistake in data that other people had missed.
strong_answer_covers: the situation and why it mattered
the result, ideally with a number

questions.question: Those are all my questions. What questions do you have for me?
strong_answer_covers: one or two specific questions about the team or the work

facts.fact: Brightwater Analytics builds dashboards that help regional hospitals plan staffing.
